decisions.title: Turn on dark mode by default for new users?
decisions.about: Most test users switch to dark within a day. Changes the first-run default only; existing users keep their setting.

decisions.title: Keep sending the weekly digest email?
decisions.about: Open rate held steady at about a third of readers for the last two months.

decisions.title: Retry failed uploads automatically, up to three times?
decisions.about: Most failures are brief network drops. Retries add at most a minute before the error shows.
decisions.detail: The retry waits 5, 15 and 40 seconds. A file that still fails is shown with its real error, and nothing is deleted.

decisions.title: Remove the beta banner from the settings page?
decisions.about: The settings page has had no new bug reports for three weeks.
